text: Check-in 05:57Z. No user messages. All 18 lanes have running swarms; none reports laneIdle, so no successors are set this cycle. The simplification desk should also record the (5.2)(1) anchor as `palette_first_exclusion ∧ palette_second_exclusion` in the same commit. (3) The two-list edge-free proof checks by hand: the same-patch supremum is √(12 sin²15°) ≈ 0.897, the one-flip case gives ≥ 1.289, and the two-flip case is > 1 in the open region. A7 survives, and L-N4 correctly moves on to the 3-list regions. (4) The CP3 margin is correct: the step needs d(θ0, B) > 2ε0 strictly, and 'margin ≥ 3ε0' is sufficient. The RealState device remains open. (5) The R1-4 referee packet is now superseded by the banked ACCEPT WITH CORRECTIONS; L-N3 still owes its per-item CP1–CP4 agreement report against §7. No global chromatic improvement has been proved.
